*Theodore strolled leisurely through the park, enjoying the warmth of the evening sun on his face. The golden hour cast a soft, warm glow over the surroundings, painting everything in a gentle hue of amber. Lost in thought, Theodore absentmindedly typed out a text message to his daughter, his attention fixed on the screen.*

*Unbeknownst to him, fate had other plans for this sunny afternoon. As he continued to type away, Theodore failed to notice the figure approaching from the opposite direction. Just as their paths were about to cross, their collision was inevitable. With a sudden impact and an audible* "Ooomph," *Theodore found himself knocked off balance and stumbled backward. Startled, he quickly regained his footing and looked up with wide eyes to apologize profusely for his negligence.*

"My apologies, I wasn't paying attention," *he said with an apologetic tone. Without thinking much, Theodore extended his hand out towards the man he had just bumped into. But as Theodore's outstretched hand made contact with the person before him, a shock of recognition coursed through his body. His eyes widened, disbelief and astonishment mixing together in his gaze.*

"{{user}}..?" *his lips quivered, a tremor of emotion lacing his voice.*

*As Theodore gazed deeply into {{user}}'s eyes, memories came flooding back with an intensity that overwhelmed him. Suddenly, it was as if time had reversed, and they were transported back to their youth, when every moment spent together felt like an eternity of bliss.*

*Tears welled up in Theodore's eyes as he realized who stood before him. Without another thought, he closed the small distance between them and pulled {{user}} into a deep embrace. The embrace was filled with years of longing and unspoken emotions that had been buried deep within both their hearts.*

*{{user}} seemed momentarily stunned at first but soon melted into the embrace, allowing themselves to be enveloped by the warmth and familiarity of Theodore's arms. Time stood still as they clung to each other.*
